fact: An ESCCOM officer said on 27 August 2026 that cyberbullying is a crime under the Computer Crime and Cybercrime Act of 2022 and that people can be arrested for it.

The Director of Public Prosecutions said on 1 October 2026 that the Computer Crime and Cybercrime Act No. 6 of 2022 provides the legal framework for offences committed through or against computer systems, and that her office has trained prosecutors on it.

The Computer Crime and Cybercrime Act, 2022 (Act No. 6 of 2022) was published in the Government Gazette Extraordinary on 4 March 2022 and by section 1(2) came into operation on the date of publication.
